# H5N1 tutorial -- [live coding session]

We are going to analzye an influenza H5N1 dataset in BEAST2. We are going to carry out two types of analysis:

## 1. 
Load the multiple sequence alignment (H5N1.nex) without reading in geographic information. Get a basic BEAST2 run to work. (We will do this part as a group).


## 2.
Repeat step 1, but also read in geographic information to estimate migration rates alongside parameters of the nucleotide
substitution model and the phylogeny. (We will also do this as a group.)


Navigate [here](https://beast2-dev.github.io/beast-docs/beast2/PhylogeographyDiscrete/AR.html) for instructions to set up the analysis,
but some modifications are needed for steps 1 and 2 above. By default, these instructions will carry out an analysis with BSSVS. Figure out how to disable BSSVS.

## 3. 
(For analysis on Day 5, but might be a good idea to run overnight to be ready in time.)

Repeat step 2, but turn the BSSVS option on.
